frame: the 140 reference comparisons of audits/aamas_gold (100 drawn from the parser's testable comparisons, 40 from its bar-less ones, after the parser was frozen)

draw.core: 70 of the 95 boxed testable items and 30 of the 35 boxed bar-less items, simple random samples without replacement (random.Random(seed).sample on the sorted ids)
draw.overlap: 21 + 9 of the core, same rule, for a second annotator
draw.optional: the other 40 items, including the 10 the paper's kit rendered without a box (their answers are void, as in the paper)
draw.blind_ids: core first then optional, each shuffled with blind_order; ids B001-B140 carry no stratum

report_by_stratum: the testable stratum is deliberately oversampled relative to the corpus; never pool the two strata
hidden_from_annotators: the run sentences (only shipped for one stratum, so showing them would reveal it)
